name: Pedal Rebel
summary:
Take your VR gaming to the next level with PEDAL REBEL VR! 

- Play SEATED or on a real exercise bike!

- LEAN in to the action to dodge oncoming traffic at breakneck speeds while boosting and stealing energy from the cars you pass, to go even faster.
